about: The brief for the two made-up AI coaches and their studio (tools/media/ai/, .claude/skills/frank-coach-video/). Change the look here, then make new looks with the design step. Describe made-up people only: never a real person's name or photo (not Frank, not a client). Plain trainers: the model gets toes wrong more often than shoes.
studio: a clean, bright, minimal photo studio: a plain off-white backdrop that curves smoothly into a light grey floor with a faint green-grey tint, with no corners, edges, windows, furniture or decorations in view
light: soft, even, diffused light from the front and both sides, true-to-life colours, and a soft natural contact shadow on the floor under the person

f.label: woman
f.person: a made-up woman of about 30: fit but realistic, an everyday athletic build with natural muscle tone, not a fitness model; natural skin texture and no heavy make-up; dark brown hair tied back in a neat low ponytail; a calm, friendly, focused face
f.outfit: a fitted short-sleeved training T-shirt in deep forest green (close to #104A2A), black training shorts to mid-thigh, and plain grey training shoes with white soles; no logos, no text, no jewellery
f.wears: a deep forest-green T-shirt and black shorts

m.label: man
m.person: a made-up man of about 35: fit but realistic, an everyday athletic build with natural muscle tone, not a bodybuilder; natural skin texture; short dark hair and a short, neat beard; a calm, friendly, focused face
m.outfit: a fitted short-sleeved training T-shirt in deep forest green (close to #104A2A), black training shorts to just above the knee, and plain grey training shoes with white soles; no logos, no text, no jewellery
m.wears: a deep forest-green T-shirt and black shorts
